answer: Require each agent to post a bond in a scarce token before it can trade, and slash that bond when independent counterparties prove collusion or fabricated work. A newcomer earns a higher trading limit only through transactions that settle and are vouched for by bonded agents with separate histories; copied identities cannot reuse those reputations. The ocean of possible personas then offers little advantage: each one needs locked capital, while a garden of cheap accounts cannot multiply influence without risking real copper-denominated losses.
